title: EStopSafeStateAndElectricalTractionDeenergizationSchemaV3
description: Comprehensive safety cutoff specification establishing decoupled electrical, mechanical, and kinetic endpoints, defining independent measurement methods, and enforcing deterministic persistence auditing.

authoritative_endpoint_naming.naming_rationale: Renamed to explicitly denote an electrical power-stage de-energization state rather than a broad systemic safe state. Current drop below 0.5 A does not guarantee vehicle stopping or DC-bus discharge.

electrical_traction_deenergized.physical_phenomenon: Motor inverter Phase U line current falls below safe threshold (I_motor < 0.5 A RMS), extinguishing electrodynamic motor torque.
electrical_traction_deenergized.measurement_method: Calibrated Hall-effect current probe (Tektronix TCP303 / A622) clamped to Motor Phase U conductor, monitored on Keysight DSO Channel 3.
does_not_prove: VEHICLE_MOTION_STOPPED (Vehicle continues rolling due to forward inertia)
MECHANICAL_BRAKE_APPLIED (Friction pads have not necessarily closed air gap)
DC_BUS_ISOLATED (Inverter bulk DC link capacitors remain energized)

contactor_open.physical_phenomenon: Main traction contactor armature mechanical separation and opening of auxiliary status microswitch contact.
contactor_open.measurement_method: Normally-open auxiliary microswitch continuity monitored via 24VDC logic probe on DSO Channel 2.
contactor_open.role: DIAGNOSTIC_PRECURSOR (Does not prove arc extinction or motor de-energization)

dc_bus_isolated.physical_phenomenon: Galvanic disconnection of battery pack and complete voltage discharge of inverter DC link bulk capacitors (V_bus < 50.0 VDC).
dc_bus_isolated.measurement_method: High-voltage isolated differential probe (e.g. Tektronix THDP0200) across inverter DC+ and DC- bus terminals.
dc_bus_isolated.relationship_to_motor_current: I_motor < 0.5 A DOES NOT EQUAL DC_BUS_ISOLATED. Inverter IGBTs gate off in < 1 ms, but DC bus capacitors can hold hazardous voltage (> 50 V) for up to several minutes.

brake_control_deenergized.physical_phenomenon: Electrical de-energization of the fail-safe spring-applied mechanical brake solenoid coil (V_brake drops from 24VDC to 0VDC).
brake_control_deenergized.measurement_method: Voltage probe across brake coil driver output terminals.
brake_control_deenergized.nature: CONTROL_ACTUATION_SIGNAL (Precedes mechanical movement; does not prove pad contact)

mechanical_brake_applied.physical_phenomenon: Mechanical displacement of brake shoe/pad across air gap and physical clamping against drive wheel or rotor.
mechanical_brake_applied.measurement_method: Caliper mechanical proximity travel sensor OR IMU longitudinal deceleration onset trace.
mechanical_brake_applied.latency_envelope: Mechanical lag typically introduces 15 to 35 ms delay after BRAKE_CONTROL_DEENERGIZED.

vehicle_motion_stopped.physical_phenomenon: Kinetic energy of vehicle completely dissipated; wheel angular velocity = 0 rad/s and chassis velocity = 0.0 m/s.
vehicle_motion_stopped.measurement_method: Wheel speed quadrature encoder frequency = 0 Hz AND vehicle longitudinal IMU acceleration returned to static bias.
vehicle_motion_stopped.stopping_distance_governance: Governed by vehicle initial kinetic energy (0.5 * m * v^2) and floor friction coefficient, evaluated per ISO 3691-4 stopping distance formula.

endpoint_persistence_audit.problem_statement: An instantaneous single-sample dip where I_motor < 0.5 A can occur due to sinusoidal zero-crossing or high-frequency inverter PWM switching noise. A deterministic persistence window T_persist is required during which I_motor must remain continuously < 0.5 A.
endpoint_persistence_audit.epistemic_qualification: No project-approved empirical persistence window has been established in prior project specifications. In accordance with Section 8 mandate ('Do NOT invent an arbitrary persistence value. Otherwise mark: TRACTION_CURRENT_ENDPOINT_PERSISTENCE = TBD and do not claim the endpoint semantics are fully closed'), this field is formally designated TBD pending physical inverter bench characterization.
endpoint_persistence_audit.closure_blocker_note: Because TRACTION_CURRENT_ENDPOINT_PERSISTENCE is TBD, Gate C8 endpoint semantics remain OPEN and physical commissioning is formally BLOCKED.

gate_c8_acceptance_rule.rule: delta_t_electrical_traction (t_electrical_traction_deenergized - t_estop_command) <= 50.0 ms WITH verified TRACTION_CURRENT_ENDPOINT_PERSISTENCE AND contactor opening <= 35.0 ms AND vendor component certificate on file.
